## What this PR does

## Target branch

Book, chapter, and OpenBook changes should target `next-revision`. Live lesson/site fixes may target `main` when they need to go out before the next book edition. Do not push to `main` directly from an agent.

## Checklist

- [ ] Clark approved the story or lines in this change (or they are already on the record)
- [ ] Nonfiction parts (Foreword, Part Five): no invented facts, events, or quotes; sources linked
- [ ] Fiction parts: embellishment follows NAMING-POLICY.md
- [ ] Transcript / Markdown twins regenerated where a public page changed (`index.md`, `llms.txt` as needed)
- [ ] Links checked
- [ ] Narration uses the current Clark voice; no laugh or chuckle tags
- [ ] Public-safe: no private details that Clark has not approved for publication
- [ ] If this is a book change, it targets `next-revision` (not `main`)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (DCO: `git commit -s`)

### Fiction / legal checklist (book changes; see book-source/NAMING-POLICY.md)

- [ ] No real names of private people, companies, schools, products, or venues in fiction chapters
- [ ] Characters drawn from real people have 2+ identifying details changed, or are composites
- [ ] No negative or embarrassing conduct attached to a traceable real person or company
- [ ] No confidential, NDA, customer, security, deal, or financial details
- [ ] No public-figure names or tells in fiction chapters, teasers, or marketing copy
- [ ] Disclaimer present where required (front matter, spoken intro, page box)
- [ ] Related `takedown-request` issues resolved
